name: Printbar
author: mryll
description: Printer status, supplies, trays and jobs (printbar) in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Click: status panel. Right click: printer web panel (EWS). Middle click: refresh.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll the printer. Each poll is one request on the LAN, so a short interval is cheap — but a sleeping printer may take a few seconds to answer.

schema.label: Config file override
schema.description: Optional. Passed to printbar as PRINTBAR_CONFIG; empty uses ~/.config/printbar/config.toml.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: Show the widget only while printing or when the printer needs attention.

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Monochrome rendering uses foreground tones only — severity stays readable through the numbers and glyphs. none: no color anywhere. bar-only: colored bar face, plain panel. panel-only: the reverse.
